description: Source code for Infineon Wi-Fi driver HAL implementation in Zephyr RTOS, including SDIO communication, OOB interrupt handling, and Wi-Fi power management.

methods.name: airoc_wifi_power_on
methods.description: Power on sequence for the Infineon Wi-Fi module, including GPIO configuration and delay.

methods.name: airoc_wifi_init_primary
methods.description: Initializes the Wi-Fi interface, SDIO functions, and attaches the Wi-Fi driver.

methods.name: whd_bus_sdio_cmd52
methods.description: Wrapper for SDIO CMD52 command to read/write a byte.

methods.name: whd_bus_sdio_cmd53
methods.description: Wrapper for SDIO CMD53 command to read/write multiple bytes.

methods.name: whd_bus_sdio_irq_handler
methods.description: SDIO interrupt handler to notify the Wi-Fi driver thread.

methods.name: whd_bus_sdio_irq_register
methods.description: Registers the SDIO interrupt handler (no operation in this implementation).

methods.name: whd_bus_sdio_oob_irq_handler
methods.description: Handles out-of-band GPIO interrupt for wake-up notifications.

methods.name: whd_bus_sdio_register_oob_intr
methods.description: Registers GPIO callback for OOB interrupt.

methods.name: whd_bus_sdio_unregister_oob_intr
methods.description: Unregisters GPIO callback for OOB interrupt.

methods.name: whd_bus_sdio_enable_oob_intr
methods.description: Enables or disables OOB GPIO interrupt.

methods.name: whd_mem_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory using Zephyr's k_calloc.
